book.title: Superforecasting
book.author: Philip E. Tetlock and Dan Gardner

predict.question: An action earns +10 on success and −5 otherwise. At a 60% success forecast, expected net points?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Superforecasting describes revising probability judgments as relevant information arrives.
modelBoundary: At 20%, action averages {A}; at 60%, {B}. The changed probability crosses the positive-expectation threshold.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? An updated probability is not automatically more accurate; forecast quality needs outcomes and scoring.
